head: Stellar Sky shows only the stars you can really see
dek: Hold your phone to the sky and Stellar draws about 200 stars you can actually pick out with your own eyes, each one named. It was #44 among paid Reference apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $8.99, by Damien Beattie.
means: If star apps feel overwhelming, this one keeps to what's really visible.
todo: Find Stellar Sky in the App Store and try it on a clear night.
thumb_words: NAME THE STARS YOU CAN SEE
